transaction.reason: The graph already binds the sole instruction to the correct positional outcome and has no missing requirement. The failure is fulfillment criteria/perception: the edited image shows a mug to the right of the headphones, but also a second mug near the center-left and a blurred blue remnant at the original mug location. The instruction does not require preserving only one mug or removing remnants, so those observations must not negate the requested right-side placement. Revise the requested check to make that explicit without adding a no-duplication requirement.
